--https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/31a6b215-ded1-4f9b-aedc-5d2d8ac208eb/ReportSectionb3bac1535211098d00e1?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq 'R01904787'





SELECT  CUST.ORGKEY AS [CustomerID]
               , CUST.Name AS [CustomerName]
               , CONCAT(CUST.Name, ' - ', CUST.ORGKEY) AS [CustomerNameID]
               , 'Retail' [CustomerType]
               , CONCAT(TRXN.SOL_ID, ' - ', BRNCH.SOL_DESC) AS Branch
               , CUST.SCD_Start_date
               , CUST.SCD_End_date
               , CONCAT ('https://app.powerbi.com/groups/864e885b-7b30-4568-9278-5a3d0be9c0ac/reports/31a6b215-ded1-4f9b-aedc-5d2d8ac208eb/ReportSectionb3bac1535211098d00e1?filter=Customer/CustomerID eq ''', CUST.ORGKEY, '''') URL
               , CUST.IsActive
               , CUST.isLatest
               , CUST.BNK_CODE
               , CUST.SOURCE_CODE
               , CUST.FILE_NAME
               , SYSDATETIMEOFFSET() AT TIME ZONE 'Singapore Standard Time' insert_dttm
               INTO EDS.CustomerNameURL
FROM EDS.CUSTOMER_DIM CUST
INNER JOIN 
(
SELECT  GAM_BANK_ID BANK_ID, CUST_ID, SOL_ID FROM EDS.DEPOSIT_FACT DEP 
UNION ALL 
SELECT  GAM_BANK_ID BANK_ID, CUST_ID, SOL_ID FROM EDS.LOAN_FACT LOAN
) TRXN ON TRXN.BANK_ID = CUST.BANK_ID AND TRXN.CUST_ID = CUST.CORE_CUST_ID
LEFT JOIN EDS.DEP_SERVICEOUTLETTABLE BRNCH ON BRNCH.SOL_ID = TRXN.SOL_ID AND BRNCH.BANK_ID =  TRXN.BANK_ID 
WHERE CUST.BANK_ID = 'CBC01' AND  LEFT(CUST.ORGKEY,1) = 'R' AND CUST.isActive = 1 AND CUST.isLatest = 1
